tabs.html:
MikroTik CSS326-24G-2S+RM – 24-Port Cloud Smart Switch with SFP+

High-Performance Layer 2 Switch for Enterprise & Data Centers
The MikroTik CSS326-24G-2S+RM is a powerful Cloud Smart Switch, designed for enterprise networks, data centers, and ISP infrastructures. Featuring 24 x Gigabit Ethernet ports and 2 x SFP+ cages, it provides high-speed connectivity, VLAN support, and advanced Layer 2 switching capabilities.

With a compact 1U rackmount design, this switch is ideal for high-density networking environments, offering low latency and high throughput for seamless data transmission.

Key Features

  • High-Speed Connectivity – 24 x Gigabit Ethernet ports + 2 x 10G SFP+ cages for ultra-fast data transfer.
  • Cloud Smart Switching – Advanced Layer 2 features including VLAN, QoS, and traffic management.
  • Dual 10G SFP+ Ports – Ideal for fiber uplinks, ensuring stable and high-speed networking.
  • Rackmount Ready – 1U standard rackmount case for seamless integration into enterprise racks.
  • User-Friendly Configuration – Easy-to-use web-based management for simplified network setup.
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Low power consumption while delivering optimal performance.
  • Reliable MikroTik Quality – Manufactured by MikroTik, made in Latvia or China.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Peace of mind with MikroTik's trusted support.

Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CSS326-24G-2S+RM
  • Ethernet Ports: 24 x Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • SFP+ Ports: 2 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Switching Capacity: 52 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 77.37 Mpps
  • Rackmount Size: 1U standard 19-inch
  • Power Supply: Included PSU
  • Management: Web-based SwOS (SwitchOS)
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia, China
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

Enterprise & Business Networks – Scalable solution for high-speed connectivity.
Data Centers & ISPs – 10G fiber uplinks ensure seamless data transfer.
High-Traffic Environments – Supports VLAN, QoS, and traffic prioritization.
Rackmount Installations – Compact 1U form factor for efficient network deployment.

Why Choose MikroTik CSS326-24G-2S+RM?

  • Cost-Effective & Powerful – Enterprise-grade performance at an affordable price.
  • 24 Gigabit Ports + 2 SFP+ – Seamless wired and fiber network integration.
  • Advanced Layer 2 Features – VLAN, QoS, and traffic control for optimized performance.
  • Reliable & Durable – Built with MikroTik's industry-leading networking technology.
